title: Scratch-off foil and thermal paper
blurb: Drag across brushed metallic foil in one ElementGL canvas to scratch an R8 mask texture, gate pointer hits via a CPU shadow mask until you clear over 35% of a control, then flip to heat-reactive thermal receipt paper.
question: Can a GPU R8 scratch-mask texture hide a live interactive HTML card behind brushed metallic foil and gate pointer hits via CPU shadow mask sync until you scratch open a control, then switch to heat-reactive thermal receipt paper warmed by a cursor stylus?
result: Measured in HeadlessChrome 160 on 2026-11-27 (all four live checks pass, 0 openSnapshots, 0 unasked readbacks). Android Chrome 159 and check:jank are not verified yet.
